extracted.intended_audience: Authors, reviewers, and journal editors preparing or appraising medical case reports (clinicians and clinical researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and reporting clinical case reports according to the CARE (CAse REport) Statement and Checklist to improve transparency and completeness of published case reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title
rubrics_metrics.description: Title (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the CARE checklist's 13 primary items; the checklist includes multiple subitems that define adequate reporting. See the CARE Statement/checklist and the CARE explanation & elaboration document for examples and detail (www.care-statement.org).

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords
rubrics_metrics.description: Keywords (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include as specified by CARE checklist subitems to improve discoverability and indexing; consult CARE explanation & elaboration for examples of appropriate keywords.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abstract should follow CARE subitems for structured summary of the case; refer to CARE explanation & elaboration for illustrative published examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide background and rationale for reporting the case per CARE subitems; explanation & elaboration document gives guidance on appropriate scope and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient information
rubrics_metrics.description: Patient information (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report relevant demographic and baseline information per CARE subitems while respecting privacy and consent; see CARE elaboration for specific data elements to include.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical findings
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinical findings (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe signs, symptoms, examination results and other pertinent clinical data as specified in CARE subitems to allow understanding and reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Timeline (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological timeline of important dates and events in the patient's course per CARE guidance; CARE elaboration shows formats/examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagnostic assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Diagnostic assessment (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report diagnostic reasoning, investigations, differential diagnoses, and their results following CARE subitems to make assessment transparent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Therapeutic interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Therapeutic interventions (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail treatments, procedures, dosages, timing, and rationale in line with CARE subitems so readers can understand interventions and their context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-up and outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow-up and outcomes (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report subsequent follow-up, outcomes, adverse events, and measures of outcome as specified by CARE subitems to communicate results and durability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret the case in context of existing literature, discuss strengths/limitations and implications per CARE guidance; see elaboration document for examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: Patient perspective (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When possible, include the patient's own perspective on their experience as recommended by CARE to enhance completeness and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informed consent
rubrics_metrics.description: Informed consent (one of the primary items of the CARE checklist).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document that informed consent for publication was obtained from the patient (or proxy) per CARE requirements and journal/institutional policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist composition (13 items with subitems)
rubrics_metrics.description: The checklist is composed of 13 items with multiple subitems descriptors which are assumed to be critical for reporting a case report with adequate details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CARE checklist's subitems define specific reporting elements for each primary item; users should consult the full checklist and the CARE explanation & elaboration document (Riley et al. 2017) for item-level detail and illustrative examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of CARE guidelines / expectation of adherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are expected to use the CARE guidelines when submitting their case reports to the Turkish Archives of Otorhinolaryngology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CARE is a consensus-based reporting guideline widely endorsed and adopted by EQUATOR; using CARE provides a framework for authors, reviewers and editors to improve completeness and transparency of case reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and completeness as reporting goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Utilizing guidelines for any type of study design provides a framework for authors, reviewers, journal editors, and readers when writing, reviewing, or appraising a scientific study and improves the completeness of published scientific reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing a case report, emphasize transparent, complete reporting following CARE to enhance scientific value and allow aggregation of case data into larger datasets.
